data.description:
# s3 doctor should fold bundle heads into the published ref, not the worktree HEAD

## Context

Split out of bug `gnarled-acardiac-bettong`, which proved the defect and closed the
silent-corruption door with a loud refusal. This ticket is the proper fix that refusal stands in
for.

`_fold_heads` in `src/rebar/_store/s3_doctor.py` merges every fetched bundle head into the
tracker worktree's HEAD and returns `git rev-parse HEAD`; `_publish_and_prune` then force-moves
`refs/heads/<ref>` onto that commit. So the heal's result is a function of whatever branch the
tracker happens to have checked out. When that is not the published ref, the checked-out
branch's commits are merged into the ticket history and published — demonstrated experimentally
on the existing harness.

`gnarled-acardiac-bettong` makes that case refuse loudly rather than corrupt. The doctor is
therefore SAFE but still unable to heal a tracker that is not sitting on the published ref.

## Why this is a design change, not a bugfix

`git merge` only merges into the checked-out branch, so targeting `refs/heads/<ref>` directly
needs a different mechanism — `git merge-tree` + `git commit-tree` to build the merge without a
worktree, or a scratch worktree/temporary gitdir checked out at the ref. Each has real
trade-offs (conflict reporting, the `.gitattributes` `merge=ours` policy the current fold relies
on, and the write-lock scope) that want deciding before implementation, which is why it was kept
out of the hardening change.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The heal folds heads into the published ref's tip regardless of the tracker's checked-out
      branch.
- [ ] No commit reachable only from the checked-out branch becomes reachable from the published
      ref.
- [ ] The existing merge policy is preserved: `.bridge_state/* merge=ours` still applies and a
      real conflict still aborts and raises rather than resolving silently.
- [ ] A tracker on a different branch, and a detached-HEAD tracker, both heal successfully —
      replacing the refusal that `gnarled-acardiac-bettong` installed.
- [ ] The refusal guard from `gnarled-acardiac-bettong` is removed or narrowed only once these
      cases genuinely heal.
data.title: s3 doctor should fold bundle heads into the published ref, not the worktree HEAD
